i18n.enTitle: Public opinion against data centers ultimately boils down to power issues.
i18n.enSummary: The growing public opinion against data centers in the United States can be seen as stemming from realistic power issues such as enormous power consumption, burden on the power grid, and environmental pollution caused by power generation facilities, rather than political and cultural antipathy toward Big Tech.
